thread.title: World leaders watch anxiously as cracks emerge in fragile U.S., Iran ceasefire
thread.title_full: World leaders watch anxiously as cracks emerge in fragile U.S., Iran ceasefire

author: @bigtaco4362
text: The complexities surrounding Pakistan's geopolitical position run deeper than what is immediately apparent. Domestically, a significant majority (90%) of Pakistan's population supports Iran's right to self-defense, and approximately 20% of the population is Shia. Concurrently, 90% of Pakistanis also back a NATO-style mutual defense pact between Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. This creates a challenging dilemma for Pakistan in choosing sides. If the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iran escalates, leading to continued attacks, their relations would be irrevocably damaged. In such a scenario, Pakistan would be forced to align itself with one side, presenting a dangerous situation. This underscores why Pakistan feels compelled to address the matter directly. Compounding this, Pakistan faces internal vulnerabilities, including a weak economy and ongoing conflicts with Afghanistan and India. Furthermore, both Pakistan and China have substantial economic interests in the region. These two nations, along with Russia, could possibly become vital lifelines for supplying weapons to Iran in a conflict in time of need. Pakistan's objective is to de-escalate the tensions between Iran and the US with help of China or extend the ceasefire. This would enable Pakistan to provide compelling reasons to Saudi Arabia for not retaliating, or to navigate a strategy that allows Pakistan to support Iran while maintaining peace between the two, thereby safeguarding Chinese and its own national economic interests. This is indeed a very serious and problematic situation. The US, for its part, does not want Pakistan to engage in a "double game" as accused in Afghan war, during this conflict, and expects Pakistan to clearly understand the implications. The potential support of Pakistan, Turkey, Russia, and China for Iran would undoubtedly lead to a highly problematic war for America and Israel, which can lead global situation further worse
